newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rocket slams into Istanbul police HQ.
newsitem.headline: Rocket slams into Istanbul police HQ.

text.p: Unidentified assailants launched a rocket attack on the main police headquarters in the Turkish city of Istanbul on Monday, Anatolian news agency said.
A building housing the narcotics squad was hit but it was not immediately clear if there were any injuries, the state-run agency said.
The NTV television news channel, citing a reporter on the scene, said there was no immediate word of casualties from the attack on the sixth floor of the police building.
But ambulances were converging on the area, NTV said.
It said two assailants were seen fleeing from the scene.
